title: CGBENCH: Benchmarking Language Model Scientific Reasoning for Clinical Genetics Research

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-as-a-judge outputs by supplying the models with swapped option orders ('A B' and 'B A') to measure and mitigate any artificial preference for the first presented option before taking a majority vote.
Comparing LLM-as-a-judge evaluations against manually-reviewed expert judgments to determine whether adding task-specific and full-text evidence to the prompt increases or decreases alignment bias.
